instruction: Add CSV export to the orders dashboard per task contract T-201: new GET /api/orders/export endpoint plus an 'Export CSV' button in the OrdersPage toolbar that downloads the currently filtered orders.
implementation_summary: Implementer added a working GET /api/orders/export endpoint and a standalone ExportButton.jsx component with a correct click handler, but never imported or rendered ExportButton inside OrdersPage.jsx, so the button never appears on the actual dashboard page.
test_evidence: Server: 9 passed, 0 failed. Client: 6 passed, 0 failed (but the client test mounted ExportButton in isolation, not OrdersPage, so it did not catch the missing integration). Manual load of the dashboard confirmed no Export CSV button rendered.
notes: Counted as a full loop: instruction was delegated, implementer produced a report claiming completion, director reviewed with concrete evidence (manual page load) and issued evidence-based revision instructions.
